seoTitle: Douglas County School District Calendar 2027–28 | Key Dates
seoDescription: View the DCSD 2027–28 calendar, including the August 11 first day, May 25 last day, school breaks, Friday delayed starts, and the official PDF.
heroSourceLine: 2027–28 calendar dates · Based on official DCSD calendar sources
verificationBadgeText: Checked against official DCSD calendar sources on August 6, 2026.
schemaDatasetDescription: Reviewed Douglas County School District dates for 2027–28, including conventional-calendar school breaks, no-school days, PLC delayed-start days, and district holidays.
heroSummary:
Douglas County School District students begin the 2027–28 school year on Wednesday, August 11, 2027, and the last student day is Thursday, May 25, 2028. The conventional calendar includes 173 student days. Fall Break is October 11–15, Thanksgiving Break is November 22–26, Winter Break runs December 20–31, and Spring Break is March 20–24.

DCSD also uses Friday delayed starts during the 2027–28 school year. District-operated elementary and middle schools begin 45 minutes later; see the full PLC schedule below.
calendarNotes: This page covers DCSD’s conventional academic calendar. Most DCSD schools follow the conventional calendar, but Renaissance Elementary Magnet School, Daniel C. Oakes High School, Eagle Academy, and DCSD charter schools may publish separate calendars. PLC Fridays are regular attendance days with a 45-minute delayed start for DCSD-operated elementary and middle schools; high schools continue their existing Friday schedule, and buses run 45 minutes later. Check your school for exact times.

whatsNew.title: What's Different From 2026–27
content: The first student day moves from August 12 in 2026–27 to August 11 in 2027–28.
Fall Break shifts from October 12–16 in 2026–27 to October 11–15 in 2027–28.
The last student day moves from May 27 in 2026–27 to May 25 in 2027–28.

The 2027–28 calendar continues 45-minute Friday delayed starts for district-operated elementary and middle schools. High schools continue their existing Friday delayed-start schedules, and school buses run 45 minutes later.

customSections.label: DCSD Friday Delayed Starts
customSections.content: During the 2027–28 school year, DCSD-operated elementary and middle schools continue to start 45 minutes later every Friday for Professional Learning Community time. High schools continue their existing Friday delayed-start schedules, and school buses also run 45 minutes later. Check your school for its exact bell time and before-school care arrangements. Charter schools may follow different schedules.

table.footnote: Dates were transcribed from the PLC markers in DCSD’s official color calendar PDF. Check your school for its exact Friday bell schedule.

customSections.label: Calendar Exceptions
customSections.content: Most DCSD schools follow this conventional calendar. Renaissance Elementary Magnet School, Daniel C. Oakes High School, Eagle Academy, and DCSD charter schools may publish their own calendars. Families at those schools should confirm dates directly with the school.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school in DCSD for 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day of the DCSD conventional calendar is Wednesday, August 11, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school?
calendarFaqs.a: DCSD’s color and list-view calendars identify Thursday, May 25, 2028, as the last student day, followed by a teacher work day on May 26. Calendar at a Glance currently lists May 26 as both the last student day and a teacher work day.

calendarFaqs.q: When are fall, winter, and spring breaks?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break is October 11–15, 2027; Winter Break is December 20–31, 2027; and Spring Break is March 20–24, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: What is a PLC delayed-start day?
calendarFaqs.a: Students still attend school on PLC Fridays, but DCSD-operated elementary and middle schools start 45 minutes later and buses run 45 minutes later. High schools continue their existing Friday delayed-start schedules; check your school for its exact bell time.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are on the calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: DCSD’s conventional calendar lists 173 student days for 2027–28.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every DCSD school follow this calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Renaissance Elementary Magnet School, Daniel C. Oakes High School, Eagle Academy, and DCSD charter schools may publish separate calendars.

sourceReviewSummary: Verified against DCSD’s academic calendars page, color calendar, list-view calendar, Calendar at a Glance, and Professional Learning Communities guidance. The 2026–27 calendar was also reviewed for the year-over-year comparison.
sourceReviewDetails: DCSD’s color calendar and list-view calendar identify Thursday, May 25, 2028 as the last student day, followed by a teacher work day on May 26. Calendar at a Glance currently lists May 26 as both the last student day and a teacher work day. Because the color and list-view calendars agree, this page uses May 25 while noting the discrepancy.

We compared the major breaks and no-school dates across DCSD’s calendar landing page, color calendar, Calendar at a Glance, and list-view PDF. Where official sources use different wording, we note the discrepancy rather than silently choosing one label.

PLC delayed-start dates were read from the light-blue PLC markers in the official color PDF. DCSD’s Professional Learning Communities page explains the 45-minute elementary and middle school delay and later bus schedules; families should confirm exact bell times with their school.
Renaissance Elementary Magnet School, Daniel C. Oakes High School, Eagle Academy, and DCSD charter schools may publish separate calendars.
